haiku:
Golden sparks ignite—
gooey hugs on sticks alight.
Sweet smoke swirls so bright.
Happy #NationalToastedMarshmallowDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Gleam of stitched night bright
Patchwork stars twirl softly high
Warm glow curls in air
Happy #FrankensteinDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Candle wax drips gold,
Soft cake crumbs on laughter’s fold—
Stories new unfold.
#HappyBirthdayMaryShelley from @ClamBakeSanta

Golden sun rises
Stock charts glow like soft sunrise
Coins dance bright cheers rise
#HappyBirthdayWarrenBuffett from @ClamBakeSanta
